verifiedEndToEnd.note: createTransaction and depositPoints exercised live on Arbitrum Sepolia with real testnet USDC (not a mock).
verifiedEndToEnd.readback: Both records read back via getTransactionByRef/getPointDepositByRef and match exactly; proxy's USDC balance is 2000000 (1+1), confirming both _pullToken calls succeeded with no fee-on-transfer mismatch.
verifiedEndToEnd.processMerchantPayment: Not exercised — would need an EIP-712 quote signed by the testnet backendSigner's private key, which this session doesn't hold (it's the known-public 0x299E4E56... key from api/.env.example, same as Base Sepolia/Arc testnet).

todo.ownership: Owner is still the deployer (0x0141781Aad86A023FaC70C6Aad0A8E7253164DB6), left that way so the same key that deployed could also run addAllowedPaymentToken/queueSweepCap/applySweepCap, same pattern as Base Sepolia and Arc testnet. Not handed to the 0x0b43A81e... multisig on this testnet deployment.
todo.verification: Not verified on Arbiscan — ETHERSCAN_API_KEY in evm/.env is blank. Run `forge verify-contract --chain 421614 <implementation> src/TakumiPay.sol:TakumiPay` once an Arbiscan (Etherscan v2 unified) key is available.
todo.nativeToken: Arbitrum Sepolia ETH is a normal separate asset (unlike Arc's USDC-is-gas aliasing), so address(0) was left un-allowlisted — only USDC is enabled for payments.
todo.withdrawalDelay: Left at 0 for continued testnet configurability. Raise via queueWithdrawalDelay/applyWithdrawalDelay before this contract is trusted with anything beyond test funds.
todo.rpc: Deployed via the public Arbitrum Sepolia RPC (https://sepolia-rollup.arbitrum.io/rpc), added to foundry.toml as the `arbitrum_sepolia` endpoint — the project's own RPC_URL in evm/.env is Arbitrum One only.
